records.text: Candace Owens said Hopkinson Aircraft Sales occupies a building separate from Atlantic Aviation, while Atlantic accepts its mail because Hopkinson has no address of its own.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Is there really an office inside of Atlantic? And remarkably, we were able to determine that Hopkinson is indeed in a building that is separate from Atlantic, but Atlantic accepts all of their mail. And the reason that Atlantic does that. ... is because Hopkinson does not actually have its own address. It's a building that stands alone and is separate from Atlantic FBO Terminal where you would fly out if you were going private.

verification.notes: Current public records confirm Hopkinson and Atlantic Aviation use the same 14600 N Airport Drive address, and Hopkinson says it moved into a Scottsdale Airport facility. They do not independently confirm that the facility is a separate standalone building or that Atlantic accepts Hopkinson's mail because Hopkinson lacks its own address.
